steps.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve, precise-object-edit, outpainting. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the current 3-column x 2-row six-expression transparent atlas of our blue-haired chibi whale maid. Image 2 is a CHARACTER/COSTUME REFERENCE ONLY, NOT a pose target: its side view naturally shows only one headphone. Revise ALL SIX front-facing sprites in Image 1 consistently. Keep the same cute face, eyes, blue hair, curled forelock, white maid headband, navy-and-white dress and central sapphire bow; preserve the exact six expression order: top row idle smile / attentive listening closed mouth / thoughtful upward glance pursed mouth; bottom row open-mouth speaking / BOTH eyes closed blink / mild worried error. Every sprite must face the viewer STRAIGHT ON, with symmetric front-facing head and shoulders. On BOTH the LEFT and RIGHT sides visibly show a matching dark oval earcup with cyan accent ring, small blue bow and outward whale-fin wing, consistent with the existing right-side design. Move a little hair aside as necessary so BOTH earcups are unmistakably visible; do not cover either one with bangs. This is a small correction, preserve character identity and large-head scale. Also extend the portrait downward by drawing more of the upper torso to the waist and a little white apron based on reference 2, instead of the current abrupt bust cut. Hands stay out of frame. IMPORTANT NEW CANVAS/GRID: output canvas 1536x1152 pixels, exactly 3 columns and 2 rows, equal PORTRAIT cells 512x576 (8:9 aspect), touching edge to edge, no separators or margins. Keep head/face near the same position and scale within the top original 512px of each cell; use the added 64px at the bottom for the torso extension. All six cells must have identical head, earcup and body registration, scale and silhouette, only facial expression changes. Surround everything with genuine alpha transparency. At the bottom of EACH cell, make the entire lower torso and hair softly fade into TRANSPARENCY over roughly the last 90 pixels, reaching zero opacity before the bottom edge, avoiding a straight cut. This must be a true alpha fade, NOT a white/blue gradient, fog, halo, glow, opaque backdrop or checkerboard drawing. Character upper face and headphones remain opaque and crisp. Preserve opaque white costume. No text, labels, extra characters, UI, frames or watermarks. Deliver one finished six-cell transparent sprite atlas, 1536x1152, with bilateral visible headphones and extended softly fading lower portraits.

Use case: background-extraction / precise alpha cleanup. Refine ONLY transparency in this existing six-expression atlas; preserve the characters, faces, bilateral headphones, extended waists/aprons, colors, exact positions, scale, 1536x1024 canvas and 3x2 equal-square grid. Do not redraw the characters or change expressions. Remove all gray/white fog and halos OUTSIDE the character silhouettes, making empty space truly alpha=0. For the LOWER 20% of EACH 512x512 cell only, apply a smooth alpha fade to the whole character (torso, apron and hair together): opaque at y=410, gradually transparent by y=494, and the FINAL 18 rows y=494..511 of EACH cell must be completely alpha=0 across the entire width. Ensure this applies independently to both atlas rows: the bottom of the top-row sprites fades to zero before y=512, not into the next row. This is a transparent opacity ramp, absolutely NO white paint, fog, light gradient, backdrop, glow or checkerboard. Keep all white headbands and upper clothing opaque, all faces and both headphones crisp and unchanged. Preserve clean antialiased hair edges above the lower fade. No cropping at the torso, no new art, no text. Deliver the same six-cell atlas as a genuine transparent PNG with only this alpha refinement.

sets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Input image is the character and costume reference only. Create a recognizable new chibi portrait set of this blue whale maid. Retain the dark navy long rippling hair with blue tips, distinctive curved forelock, blue eyes, porcelain white ruffle maid crown, two visible natural whale-fin ears, the small cyan bow beside HER left fin, navy dress with warm gold buttons and white bib/apron. Keep a small dark neck bow and blue brooch. Aim for her lively open warmth and delicate navy, cobalt, and cream palette. Keep both hands offscreen; omit the lower-body tail. Do not invent headphones or earcups. Asset type: one production sprite sheet for a tiny 240x320 embedded LCD. Generate a 1536x1024 landscape transparent PNG with precisely 3 columns by 2 rows of identical 512x512 square cells and no gutter, in this exact reading order: top left calm closed-mouth smile (idle), top middle alert eyes with a small closed mouth (listening), top right pupils looking slightly up and small pursed mouth (thinking); bottom left clearly open-mouth cheerful talking (speaking), bottom middle both eyes closed in a soft blink, bottom right worried brows and small downturned mouth (error). Same character and pose, not six redesigns. Copy the exact same waist-up portrait at the exact same local position and scale into all six cells; change only eyebrows, eyes, and mouth. This registration is essential for animation on a small screen. Each cell: silhouette fits x=45..467, first hair/accessory around y=24; generous very readable head centered at x=256 with eye line at approximately y=224 and face filling the top 60 percent, upper torso continues through the last quarter. Entire hair and costume gently fade in genuine alpha through the final 64 px; fully transparent on EACH cell's edges. Present the character straight-on, no tilt. Use high quality, clean anime game portrait linework, simple cel shading, big readable shapes and strong ink edges for small display. No full body, no scenic background, no color backdrop, fog, shadows or checker tiles, no expression symbols, lettering, watermark, UI or cell borders. The only visible things are the six waist-up sprites. Keep whites on the costume fully opaque above the fade.
